dedupe_keys.name: hyfo hydrology and climate forecasting tools

description: hyfo is an R package for hydrological and climate-forecast data processing. Its README says the project began in EUPORIAS and was developed with DHI Denmark, and points to package documentation and CRAN installation. Users supply forecast or observed hydrometeorological series; outputs are processed series and visual summaries for the chosen catchment and season. Geographic coverage follows the input locations and source forecast grids. Its package DESCRIPTION states GPL-2 licensing, and the GitHub and CRAN package is public. A limitation is that processing a forecast does not establish local hydrological skill, and utilities must be matched to a basin's time step and units. The package can prepare forcing or diagnostics for river, reservoir and flood-defence simulation. The related ERA5 catalogue record supplies meteorological fields but not these hydrology-oriented routines. No forecast data or package was downloaded.
